steps.message:
## Summary: Bug Fix Complete

### Bug
**No Compliance of the Trainings Type Slider** — The TrainingsType Spinner (`trainSpinner`) in the General Training Schedule Editor was displayed but its value was never saved to the Schedule object, never persisted to the XML file, and never displayed in the Schedule View.

### Root Causes (3 files)
1. **`GeneralTrainingScheduleEditor.java`** — The Spinner value was never read; `schedule.setTrainingsType()` was never called
2. **`XMLParser.java`** — TrainingsType read/write code was commented out
3. **`ExerciseViewActivity.java`** + **`MyScheduleRecyclerViewAdapter.java`** — ScheduleInfo and list items didn't display the TrainingType

### Changes Made (5 files)

| File | Change |
|------|--------|
| **`GeneralTrainingScheduleEditor.java`** | Added imports for `Spinner` and `TrainingsTypes`. In `addScheduleToModel()`, added code to read `trainSpinner.getSelectedItem()`, convert it to `TrainingsTypes` enum, and call `schedule.setTrainingsType()` |
| **`XMLParser.java`** | Added `TrainingsTypes` import. Replaced commented-out code with active parsing of `trainingstype` attribute from XML (with null-safe check). Added active serialization of `trainingstype` attribute to XML (with null-safe check) |
| **`ExerciseViewActivity.java`** | Updated `onStart()` to include training type name in the `ScheduleInfo` string format (5th format parameter) |
| **`strings.xml`** | Updated `ScheduleInfo` format string from 4 to 5 parameters: added `\nTraining Type: %5$s` |
| **`MyScheduleRecyclerViewAdapter.java`** | Updated `onBindViewHolder()` to append training type in parentheses after the schedule name (e.g., `"MySchedule (hypertrophy)"`) |

### Verification
